hoysala.desc: On both sides of the entrance are two large sculptures of Sala fighting a tiger, the emblem of the Hoysalas. According to Kannada folklore, Sala, a young warrior, saved his Jain guru Sudatta by striking down a lion or tiger near the temple of the goddess Vasantika at Angadi (now called Sosevuru). Before the 17th-century, it was a major city of the Vijayanagara Empire and regional capital for regional governors such as Pemmasani Ramalinga Naidu.
